name_en: WQ101 Alpha2 Volume Delta Intrabar Corr
name_zh: WQ101 Alpha2 成交量变化K线内相关
formula_zh: -corr(rank(log成交量2期变化), rank((收盘-开盘)/开盘), 6)
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 8h bars.
intuition_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配8小时K线。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 方向故意设为条件式以避免事后拟合。需实证诊断。
known_limitations_en: Short rolling correlation of ranked log-volume delta and intrabar return can be noisy around volume spikes.
known_limitations_zh: 排名后的log成交量变化与K线内收益短窗口相关在放量附近可能噪音较大。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 8 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：8根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.
